svg.text: Token Titans · 40-step probabilistic imbalance price forecast · deep learning architectures
One sample = one forecast origin + the next 40 quarter-hours (10 hours); all architectures share features, labels and loss, and differ only in the Backbone cell.
A · Main data flow (DAG): features → Encode cell → Backbone cell → Prob head cell → three output heads + loss
m = 0: label zeroed, not in loss
Total loss (mean over (origin, step) cells with mask m = 1)
B1 · Encode cell (per feature; scaler fitted on training rows only)
* when missing or for selected features
B3 · Decoupled two-tower head (#6–#9): median gets L1 gradient only
C · Backbone cell expanded (1 of 9; input X_state, X_step, output h)
Per-step MLP, the same view as GBDT
FiLM γ·c + β (γ, β from state)
Learns residuals on LightGBM OOF forecasts
TiDE (1 encoder layer) → Δ (zero init, gate 0.15)
Starts equal to LightGBM; block OOF in training,
Ds state tokens + Dh variable tokens
D · Training and inference (per fold, per architecture)

Optimiser: AdamW (lr 1.5e-3, wd 1.5e-3) · cosine decay · gradient clip 1.0 · EMA 0.98/0.99 · batch 32/128 origins · at most 38 epochs · labels and scaler use only data published before the cutoff (no leakage)
